## Northgate Clinic — account profile (Jan–Jun 2026)

**Identity note first:** in `accounts.csv`, "Northgate Clinic" isn't one account_id — it's `ACC-1042` (valid through 2026-03-31), which hands off with no gap or overlap to `ACC-1077`, named "Northgate Health Partners (formerly Northgate Clinic)" (valid from 2026-04-01). The rename is stated in the data itself, so I've treated both IDs as the same entity for this profile.

**Month by month:**

| Month | Contract status | Plan / billing | Tickets |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jan | active | standard, 1,840 units, $772.80 | 1 (feature-request) |
| Feb | **paused** | *no billing row* | none |
| Mar | active | plan changed to enterprise-annual (eff. 2026-03-01); 1,910 units, $592.10 | 2 (feature-request, integration) |
| Apr | active (now ACC-1077) | enterprise-annual, 1,120 units, $347.20 | 2, both billing-question, within 4 days of the ID switching |
| May | active | enterprise-annual, 1,085 units, $336.35 | 1 (outage-report) |
| Jun | *no data* | *no billing row* | none |

Over the six months: 7 tickets total, split feature-request (2), integration (2), billing-question (2), outage-report (1).

**Things worth flagging, not concluding:**
- The Feb billing gap lines up with the "paused" contract status that month — that's a clean explanation.
- The Jun billing/ticket gap is not the same story. `contract_status.csv` has no June rows for *any* account in the dataset (that field just stops in May, a dataset-wide export gap). But June billing rows exist for the other three accounts and not for Northgate — so this absence is specific to Northgate, and this data doesn't say whether that's paused/ended, an export miss, or genuinely no activity.
- The per-unit rate dropped noticeably at the same time the plan switched to enterprise-annual (~$0.42/unit → ~$0.31/unit) — a sequence, not a claimed cause.
- Both billing-question tickets cluster right after the account renamed to ACC-1077/Northgate Health Partners — also just a sequence worth noting.

None of the above is confirmed causally — that would be `hypothesis-driven-analysis` work if you want any of these settled (particularly the June gap or the rename/billing-ticket timing).

Full orientation notes and source-by-source detail are in `/var/folders/q1/yy47kpf51gb44d8wg1ywz4p80000gq/T/arm-b10-post-7_z79j3p/work/exploration-log-northgate.md`.
